compute_word_length: compute the average word length of a list of strings using the WordLength measurement
load_word_length_module: load the word_length measurement module from the HuggingFace evaluate library
tokenize_with_nltk: tokenize input strings with NLTK word_tokenize to count words for length calculation
download_nltk_resources: download NLTK punkt or punkt_tab tokenizer resources for word_length computation
get_measurement_info: get the measurement info including features, description, and citation for WordLength
